fields.v: Partly (0.5): eight authors at universities, not vendors of the agents or models evaluated; affiliation of two authors (Li R., Mao) printed as 'Somewhere on the Earth', so their independence cannot be established (missing information)
fields.why: The justification says all authors are at universities, but two authors have no real affiliation, so independence from the evaluated vendors is not fully established and the missing-information rule may apply.
fields.doubt: Dois autores (Rongqing Li e Kelong Mao) têm como afiliação 'Somewhere on the Earth', ou seja, não se sabe onde trabalham. A justificação diz que todos são de universidades. Vê a pág. 1 e decide se a Q12 fica Sim ou passa a Parcial por falta de informação.
